entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Queen of England (1558–1603), daughter of Henry VIII and Anne Boleyn. Elizabeth's reign — the Elizabethan era — saw the flowering of English literature, the defeat of the Spanish Armada, and the religious settlement that established Anglicanism.
